usage: The word 海鷗 (hoi2 au1) is a noun referring to the bird known as a seagull.
You can use 海鷗 as the subject of a sentence: 海鷗喺海邊飛。 (The seagull flies by the sea.)
海鷗 can also be used as the object when describing actions related to the bird: 我見到好多海鷗。 (I see many seagulls.)
It's common to use 海鷗 in conversations about nature, the beach, or birds.
You rarely need measure words before 海鷗 when talking in general, but you can use 隻 (zek3) if counting specific seagulls.
